name: FlexiQuiz
summary: Online quiz and test maker for educators, trainers and businesses: build graded exams, assessments and simple courses with certificates, timed tests, question banks and analytics — from a genuinely free tier.
best_for: educators, trainers and small teams that want professional graded quizzes, exams and simple courses — with certificates, timed tests, question banks and analytics — without building out a full LMS
skip_if: you need a complete learning platform with deep integrations, or your volumes run past a few thousand responses a month — the caps make it the wrong shape
honest_knock: The monthly response caps are the business model: 20 on free, 500 on Essentials, 2,000 on Premium and 25,000 on Enterprise -- one viral quiz or one big exam cohort and you're shopping a tier up. The cap hits the participant, not you: in our test on 20 October 2026 the 21st respondent of the month saw only 'This account has reached the maximum monthly response limit' instead of the quiz. The free plan also stops at 10 questions, a limit that only shows up when you save the eleventh. The per-response price falls steeply as you climb ($0.034, $0.0125, $0.0024 on yearly billing), so the ceiling is the thing to price, not the sticker. Administrator seats are capped separately at 1, 2 and 15, and sharing a login is against the terms.

pricing.entry_price_terms: per month billed monthly or $17/mo billed yearly ($204/yr)
pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-09-22 on flexiquiz.com/Home/Plans, every amount unchanged; the monthly-billed rates were read from the page's own billing-toggle script, the yearly rates from the rendered cards) Free: 20 responses a month, no card required; in our test on 20 October 2026 a free quiz also stopped at 10 questions ('There is a maximum of 10 questions on the free plan'). Essentials $25/mo billed monthly or $17/mo billed yearly ($204/yr) -- 500 responses a month, 1 administrator, unlimited quizzes and questions, question bank, live quizzes, auto grading. Premium $39/mo monthly or $25/mo yearly ($300/yr) -- 2,000 responses a month, 2 administrators or trainers, learning paths, selling quizzes and courses, custom certificates, embedding, self-registration. Enterprise $89/mo monthly or $60/mo yearly ($720/yr) -- 25,000 responses a month, 15 administrators or trainers, APIs and webhooks, single sign-on, white-label emails, custom CSS, 100 custom groups, 24/7 priority support. Enterprise+ is tailored and quoted by sales. Yearly billing works out 32-36% cheaper than monthly, which is more than the 'save over 25%' the toggle advertises. Purchases over $300 can be invoiced for bank transfer or cheque against an additional $50 fee.

sessions.what: Tested by our team on 20 October 2026 on a free account: Daan created the account and our AI assistant built the quiz in his browser and sent the answers as an anonymous visitor without logging in. We built one multiple-choice quiz, pushed it past the question limit, published it and submitted answers until the monthly response limit was reached.
findings: Ten questions saved. The form for an eleventh opened normally, and only on Save did FlexiQuiz say 'There is a maximum of 10 questions on the free plan. Upgrade to add more questions'; the eleventh was not saved.

A new quiz is published with 'Maximum attempts' set to 1 and a registration page that requires first name, last name and email. We raised the attempts to 30 and switched registration off; the quiz link then worked without a login.
Grading was correct: a submission with only questions 1-3 right scored '3/10 (30%)', and the 19 fully correct ones scored '10/10 (100%)'.
Analyze showed 'Total respondents 20' with Pass/Fail per submission, and the Response Summary (questions 1-3 at 100% correct, 4-10 at 95%) matched our own log exactly.
The 21st respondent of the month could not even start: the quiz link showed only 'This account has reached the maximum monthly response limit' instead of the quiz.
The preview submission got stuck and did not count as a respondent.
Timestamps in Analyze read 9:31 AM at about 17:30 our local time: the default time zone was not ours (Europe/Amsterdam).

claim_checks.claim: "20 responses a month" and "10 questions per quiz" on the free account
claim_checks.observed: Saving an eleventh question gave 'There is a maximum of 10 questions on the free plan'. After 20 submissions the quiz link showed only 'This account has reached the maximum monthly response limit'.
claim_checks.plan: Free, one quiz, submissions as an anonymous visitor
claim_checks.comparability: Same quantities. With one quiz we cannot tell the per-quiz and per-account limits apart.
claim_checks.buying_consequence: The limit stops the 21st participant before they can start, so the free plan does not fit a group of more than 20 people a month.
